text: #668's ratified acceptance test TestRetainedQueueRegistrationModes668 expected a planning registration's tool check and fresh final check to open 2 environments. #621's ratified isolation (D-0371), which merged first as #685, gives each acceptance invocation a fresh container beside its commands' shared one. The fixture's plan has two acceptance tests, so the same two checks open 6. Both plans' behavior is as ratified; only that count was stale. At #668's merge the test expects 6 opens and 6 closes, with every other assertion unchanged. The plan's pinned copy keeps the original count, and this decision records the difference. #668 lands through a person's pull request that carries #690's own commit, as #654 did (D-0373).
